HOW TO PLAY

YOUR TURN

  • Tap a skill on one of your disciples (bottom row). For a single-target skill, an aiming arrow appears: drag it onto a glowing target and release, or tap the target. Right-click, Esc, or tapping empty space cancels.
  • Area skills hit everyone highlighted. Tap the skill again (or any highlighted card) to cast.
  • Each disciple uses one skill per turn. Then press END TURN.
  • Hover (mouse) or press and hold (touch) any skill, card, status, or Qi orb for exact numbers.

QI

  • At the start of your turn, every living disciple makes 1 Qi of its element. Unused Qi carries over (max 10).
  • Costs: light = 1 Qi of the disciple's element, medium = 2, finisher = 2 + 1 of any element (rainbow dot). Finishers and control skills have a cooldown.

ROLES

Lin Qinglian: heals and shields. Xiao Yu: debuffs and Qi generation. Feng Wuyan and Su Meiyan: damage.

QI SURGE (combo)

Use skills one after another in the generating cycle order:

Each link gives +1 Qi next turn, of the element that received the link (Water → Wood gives +1 Wood). Best chain with this team: Feng → Lin → Xiao Yu → Su (+3 Qi). A gold Surge badge marks who continues the chain.

ELEMENTS

The overcoming cycle: attacking an element you beat deals +30% (WEAK!).

Cultists wield Shadow, which has no weakness, but some hide a second element. Finding out what each enemy is weak to is up to you: watch for the WEAK! popup. Enemy attacks can hit your weak spots too.

CONTROL

Seal: next attack deals 40% less, and wears off after that unit's turn. Stun/Charm: skips one action, then the unit is Resolute (immune to stun) for 2 turns, so nobody can be stun-locked.

HEAVENLY TRIBULATION

From turn 9, all damage rises by +20% per turn, and from turn 12 heavenly lightning also strikes every card at the start of its turn (150 × turns past 11), so no battle (or PvP match) can stall forever.
